purpose: Classifies six Evergreen supervisory controls -- transaction permissioning, contract deployment permissioning, native asset issuance, fee policy, reward distribution, and validator set membership -- as protocol-enforced, application-enforced, or absent, from caller-transcribed genesis precompile configuration and validator-manager mode. Distinct from the segregation-of-duties matrix checker: that tool asks who holds conflicting power, this asks where the control lives at all. An undeclared input never falls through to a silent guess -- it becomes a named judgment_required entry naming the undetermined fact, the input that resolves it, and who decides. Zero network, zero PII -- opaque control and precompile keys only.

trust_label: deferred -- deterministic source published, zkVM proof not yet generated -- New node landed by AVAX-PERM-1 as a disjoint shard: the zkVM receipt is generated by the asynchronous GPU proving queue after the shard is folded into chaingraph.json by ASSEMBLE-LAND, because the guest cannot be built against a kernel that is not yet in the assembled monolith. The kernel is fully deterministic and its sha256-source identity is published in compute_images, so the proof can be attached later without any hash-moving edit.
